spec.description: Admiralty, the Hong Kong MTR station where four lines meet on eight floors down to 34 m under the street, from the Lands Department's 3D Indoor Map, with the trains at its eight platforms placed from MTR's live Next Train times.

spec.rawSql:
-- Admiralty station from the Lands Department's 3D Indoor Map (datasets/mtr-admiralty): its
-- platforms, tracks, escalators, stairs, lifts, concourses, toilets and shops, floor by floor.
SELECT unit, kind, name, level, floor_name, area_m2, geometry
FROM 'http://feeds/datasets/mtr-admiralty/units.parquet'

-- Each floor's outline, the slab it stands on.
SELECT level, floor_name, z_mpd, geometry
FROM 'http://feeds/datasets/mtr-admiralty/floors.parquet'

-- Each floor's outline as a low wall.
SELECT level, floor_name, height_m, geometry
FROM 'http://feeds/datasets/mtr-admiralty/walls.parquet'

-- Exits, gates, customer service, toilets, defibrillators, shops and the platforms' own markers
-- (what a link with var-platform flies to).
SELECT kind, name, coalesce(label, '') AS label,
       CASE WHEN kind = 'Platform' THEN 'Platform ' || label END AS platform,
       level, floor_name, latitude, longitude
FROM 'http://feeds/datasets/mtr-admiralty/points.parquet'
WHERE kind <> 'Platform' OR label IS NOT NULL

-- MTR's Next Train API (data.gov.hk), through the gateway's 10 s cache: the next four trains
-- each way on the four lines at Admiralty, their platform and estimated time (Hong Kong time,
-- UTC+8, to the second).
WITH feed AS (
  SELECT line, from_json(r->>'body', '{"sys_time":"VARCHAR","data":"JSON"}') AS j
  FROM (SELECT line, http_get('http://feeds/mtr/nexttrain/' || line || '/ADM') AS r
        FROM (VALUES ('ISL'), ('TWL'), ('SIL'), ('EAL')) v(line))
  WHERE (r->>'status') = '200'
),
next AS (
  SELECT f.line, t.seq::INTEGER AS seq, t.dest, t.plat::INTEGER AS plat,
         strptime(t."time", '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') - INTERVAL 8 HOUR AS due
  FROM feed f, (VALUES ('UP'), ('DOWN')) d(dir),
       unnest(from_json(f.j.data -> (f.line || '-ADM') -> d.dir,
                        '[{"seq":"VARCHAR","dest":"VARCHAR","plat":"VARCHAR","time":"VARCHAR"}]')) u(t)
  WHERE regexp_matches(t."time", '^\d{4}-\d\d-\d\d \d\d:\d\d:\d\d$')
),
places(code, place) AS (VALUES
  ('ADM', 'Admiralty'), ('TSW', 'Tsuen Wan'), ('CEN', 'Central'), ('KET', 'Kennedy Town'), ('CHW', 'Chai Wan'),
  ('SOH', 'South Horizons'), ('LMC', 'Lok Ma Chau'), ('LOW', 'Lo Wu'), ('SHS', 'Sheung Shui'),
  ('TAP', 'Tai Po Market'), ('RAC', 'Racecourse'), ('FOT', 'Fo Tan'), ('SHT', 'Sha Tin'), ('HUH', 'Hung Hom'),
  ('MKK', 'Mong Kok East'), ('UNI', 'University'), ('TAW', 'Tai Wai'), ('KOT', 'Kowloon Tong'),
  ('OCP', 'Ocean Park'), ('WCH', 'Wong Chuk Hang'), ('LET', 'Lei Tung'), ('TST', 'Tsim Sha Tsui'),
  ('MOK', 'Mong Kok'), ('LAK', 'Lai King'), ('KWF', 'Kwai Fong'), ('NOP', 'North Point'), ('SKW', 'Shau Kei Wan'),
  ('HFC', 'Heng Fa Chuen'), ('CAB', 'Causeway Bay'), ('QUB', 'Quarry Bay'), ('TAK', 'Tai Koo'),
  ('SWH', 'Sai Wan Ho'), ('SYP', 'Sai Ying Pun'), ('SHW', 'Sheung Wan'), ('HKU', 'HKU'), ('WAC', 'Wan Chai')),
-- Where each train is now. MTR publishes times, not positions: a train ending here or running
-- through comes in over the 30 s before its time, braking to its stop 3 m short of the
-- platform's end, waits 30 s and pulls out; one leaving a terminus platform (5, 6, 7) waits
-- there the 2 minutes before its time, then goes back out the way it came.
pos AS (
  SELECT n.*, coalesce(pl.place, n.dest) AS destination, p.platform, p.line_name, p.level, p.floor_name,
         p.latitude, p.longitude, p.x_stop, p.train_m, p.car_m, p.terminus,
         epoch(n.due) - epoch(now()) AS s,
         n.dest = 'ADM' OR NOT p.terminus AS arrives
  FROM next n
  JOIN 'http://feeds/datasets/mtr-admiralty/platforms.parquet' p USING (plat)
  LEFT JOIN places pl ON pl.code = n.dest
),
moving AS (
  SELECT *,
         CASE WHEN arrives AND s BETWEEN 0 AND 30 THEN 'Arriving'
              WHEN arrives AND s BETWEEN -30 AND 0 THEN 'At the platform'
              WHEN arrives AND NOT terminus AND s BETWEEN -55 AND -30 THEN 'Leaving'
              WHEN NOT arrives AND s BETWEEN 0 AND 120 THEN 'At the platform'
              WHEN NOT arrives AND s BETWEEN -25 AND 0 THEN 'Leaving'
         END AS state,
         CASE WHEN arrives AND s BETWEEN 0 AND 30 THEN x_stop - 250 * (s / 30) ^ 2
              WHEN arrives AND s BETWEEN -30 AND 0 THEN x_stop
              WHEN arrives AND NOT terminus AND s BETWEEN -55 AND -30 THEN x_stop + 0.6 * (-s - 30) ^ 2
              WHEN NOT arrives AND s BETWEEN 0 AND 120 THEN x_stop
              WHEN NOT arrives AND s BETWEEN -25 AND 0 THEN x_stop - 0.6 * s ^ 2
         END AS front
  FROM pos
)
-- Each train as the metre slices of track it covers, a 1 m gap between its cars, 3.7 m high.
SELECT m.line_name AS line, m.platform, m.destination, m.state,
       strftime(m.due + INTERVAL 8 HOUR, '%H:%M:%S') AS due_hkt,
       floor((m.front - sl.x) / m.car_m)::INTEGER + 1 AS car,
       sl.level, sl.floor_name, 3.7 AS height_m, sl.geometry
FROM moving m
JOIN 'http://feeds/datasets/mtr-admiralty/slices.parquet' sl
  ON sl.plat = m.plat AND sl.x >= m.front - m.train_m AND sl.x < m.front
 AND fmod(m.front - sl.x, m.car_m) < m.car_m - 1
WHERE m.state IS NOT NULL

-- MTR's Next Train API (data.gov.hk), through the gateway's 10 s cache: the next four trains
-- each way on the four lines at Admiralty, their platform and estimated time (Hong Kong time,
-- UTC+8, to the second).
WITH feed AS (

next AS (
  SELECT f.line, t.seq::INTEGER AS seq, t.dest, t.plat::INTEGER AS plat,
         strptime(t."time", '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') - INTERVAL 8 HOUR AS due
  FROM feed f, (VALUES ('UP'), ('DOWN')) d(dir),
       unnest(from_json(f.j.data -> (f.line || '-ADM') -> d.dir,
                        '[{"seq":"VARCHAR","dest":"VARCHAR","plat":"VARCHAR","time":"VARCHAR"}]')) u(t)
  WHERE regexp_matches(t."time", '^\d{4}-\d\d-\d\d \d\d:\d\d:\d\d$')
),
places(code, place) AS (VALUES
  ('ADM', 'Admiralty'), ('TSW', 'Tsuen Wan'), ('CEN', 'Central'), ('KET', 'Kennedy Town'), ('CHW', 'Chai Wan'),
  ('SOH', 'South Horizons'), ('LMC', 'Lok Ma Chau'), ('LOW', 'Lo Wu'), ('SHS', 'Sheung Shui'),
  ('TAP', 'Tai Po Market'), ('RAC', 'Racecourse'), ('FOT', 'Fo Tan'), ('SHT', 'Sha Tin'), ('HUH', 'Hung Hom'),
  ('MKK', 'Mong Kok East'), ('UNI', 'University'), ('TAW', 'Tai Wai'), ('KOT', 'Kowloon Tong'),
  ('OCP', 'Ocean Park'), ('WCH', 'Wong Chuk Hang'), ('LET', 'Lei Tung'), ('TST', 'Tsim Sha Tsui'),
  ('MOK', 'Mong Kok'), ('LAK', 'Lai King'), ('KWF', 'Kwai Fong'), ('NOP', 'North Point'), ('SKW', 'Shau Kei Wan'),
  ('HFC', 'Heng Fa Chuen'), ('CAB', 'Causeway Bay'), ('QUB', 'Quarry Bay'), ('TAK', 'Tai Koo'),
  ('SWH', 'Sai Wan Ho'), ('SYP', 'Sai Ying Pun'), ('SHW', 'Sheung Wan'), ('HKU', 'HKU'), ('WAC', 'Wan Chai')),
-- Where each train is now. MTR publishes times, not positions: a train ending here or running
-- through comes in over the 30 s before its time, braking to its stop 3 m short of the
-- platform's end, waits 30 s and pulls out; one leaving a terminus platform (5, 6, 7) waits
-- there the 2 minutes before its time, then goes back out the way it came.
pos AS (
  SELECT n.*, coalesce(pl.place, n.dest) AS destination, p.platform, p.line_name, p.level, p.floor_name,
         p.latitude, p.longitude, p.x_stop, p.train_m, p.car_m, p.terminus,
         epoch(n.due) - epoch(now()) AS s,
         n.dest = 'ADM' OR NOT p.terminus AS arrives
  FROM next n
  JOIN 'http://feeds/datasets/mtr-admiralty/platforms.parquet' p USING (plat)
  LEFT JOIN places pl ON pl.code = n.dest
),
moving AS (
  SELECT *,
         CASE WHEN arrives AND s BETWEEN 0 AND 30 THEN 'Arriving'
              WHEN arrives AND s BETWEEN -30 AND 0 THEN 'At the platform'
              WHEN arrives AND NOT terminus AND s BETWEEN -55 AND -30 THEN 'Leaving'
              WHEN NOT arrives AND s BETWEEN 0 AND 120 THEN 'At the platform'
              WHEN NOT arrives AND s BETWEEN -25 AND 0 THEN 'Leaving'
         END AS state,
         CASE WHEN arrives AND s BETWEEN 0 AND 30 THEN x_stop - 250 * (s / 30) ^ 2
              WHEN arrives AND s BETWEEN -30 AND 0 THEN x_stop
              WHEN arrives AND NOT terminus AND s BETWEEN -55 AND -30 THEN x_stop + 0.6 * (-s - 30) ^ 2
              WHEN NOT arrives AND s BETWEEN 0 AND 120 THEN x_stop
              WHEN NOT arrives AND s BETWEEN -25 AND 0 THEN x_stop - 0.6 * s ^ 2
         END AS front
  FROM pos
)
-- A sign over each platform: its number, the next train's destination and when; trains_in
-- counts the trains in the platform now (the floor picker adds them up per floor).
SELECT p.plat, coalesce(t.destination, p.toward) || ' · ' ||
         CASE WHEN t.s IS NULL THEN '-'
              WHEN t.state IS NOT NULL THEN lower(t.state)
              WHEN t.s > 3600 THEN 'at ' || strftime(t.due + INTERVAL 8 HOUR, '%H:%M')
              ELSE ceil(t.s / 60)::INTEGER || ' min' END AS sign,
       -- no other text column: the sign card's title would be it
       p.level, p.latitude, p.longitude, coalesce(t.trains_in, 0) AS trains_in
FROM 'http://feeds/datasets/mtr-admiralty/platforms.parquet' p
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT plat, arg_min(destination, due) AS destination, arg_min_null(state, due) AS state, min(due) AS due,
         arg_min(s, due) AS s, count(*) FILTER (WHERE state IS NOT NULL) AS trains_in
  FROM moving WHERE s > -55 GROUP BY plat
) t ON t.plat = p.plat

options.content: ### About the data **The station.** The [3D Indoor Map](https://portal.csdi.gov.hk/csdi-webpage/dataset/landsd_rcd_1671437329821_60808) of the Lands Department, made with MTR Corporation, from the CSDI Portal's Map API: Admiralty's eight floors, from the South Island Line 34 m under the street (L6) to the landscape deck (U1), with their platforms, tracks, escalators, lifts and shops. Built once per instance by `datasets/mtr-admiralty/build.sh`. **The trains.** [Real-time MTR train information](https://data.gov.hk/en-data/dataset/mtr-data2-nexttrain-data) (MTR Corporation, DATA.GOV.HK): the next four trains each way on the Island, Tsuen Wan, South Island and East Rail lines, with their platform and estimated time. MTR publishes times, not positions: the map places each train from its time (in over the last 30 s, braking to its stop, 30 s at the platform, then out; at the terminus platforms 5, 6 and 7, waiting two minutes before leaving the way it came), its length from the cars the line runs. No trains run between about 01:00 and 06:00 Hong Kong time. Map from Lands Department. Source: the Government of the HKSAR and the CSDI Portal.
